description: This file defines extension methods for JSON serialization and deserialization using System.Text.Json, providing convenient 'FromJson' and 'ToJson' methods for strings and objects within the ApplicationCore.Extensions namespace.

classes.name: JsonExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for JSON serialization/deserialization with custom options.

methods.name: FromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into an object of type T using custom JsonSerializerOptions.

methods.name: ToJson
methods.description: Serializes an object of type T into a JSON string using custom JsonSerializerOptions.
